calculation.description: Ranks the 15 tradable benchmark instruments by the negative trailing three-session return; recent losers receive higher scores for short-horizon mean reversion.
calculation.timing: computed after the previous completed daily close; applied to the next session

validation.regime_notes: Validated across 2,225 dates and all 15 instruments over the shared 2020-2026 synthetic history. Positive decay through 10 sessions. Highly related but distinct from the admitted 5-day reversal (absolute return-series correlation 0.752); interpret uncertainty conservatively given the small cross-section.
